written.headline: Google introduces Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
written.summary: Google released a Tool Retrieval feature in preview for the Gemini Interactions API to help agents manage large tool libraries. The feature loads tool parameter schemas on demand to reduce input token counts and latency.
